intros.taunt: I’ll be in your box before this speech bubble disappears.
victoryLines: I slowed down for the replay. You’re welcome.
I finished celebrating before your team finished turning around.

intros.taunt: My shooting coach said “keep your eyes on the ball.” I may have overdone it.
victoryLines: Coach, I kept my eye on the ball. Your keeper should try it.
That wasn’t a shooting lane. I made one.

intros.taunt: Team, assemble! Yes, even the substitute keeper.
victoryLines: I rallied eleven players. You couldn’t rally four defenders.
Coach, next time bring a plan your whole team can follow.

intros.taunt: Please don’t make me angry. The groundskeeper just fixed the goalposts.
My superpower is preparation. My backup superpower is an absurd transfer budget.
victoryLines: Coach, I prepared for every move. You prepared an excuse.
I knew your game plan before your players did.
